body_text:
A left action of a group $G$ on a set $X$ is a map
$G\times X\to X$, written $(g,x)\mapsto g\cdot x$, satisfying
$e\cdot x=x$ and $(gh)\cdot x=g\cdot(h\cdot x)$. Equivalently,
an action is a homomorphism $G\to\operatorname{Sym}(X)$ into
the group of bijections of $X$.
